meta.title: Tech stack | HimoSoft
meta.description: Languages, frameworks, and infrastructure HimoSoft uses for pragmatic delivery.

tech-stack.title: Tech stack notes
tech-stack.intro: We choose boring technology where possible and exciting technology where it earns its keep. Stacks vary by project; below is a representative set.

sections.title: Frontend
paragraphs: TypeScript, React, Next.js, and modern CSS. We favour component libraries and design tokens when products need long-term UI consistency.

sections.title: Backend
paragraphs: Node.js, Python, and PHP where legacy requires it. APIs are documented with OpenAPI or equivalent; auth uses industry-standard patterns.

sections.title: Data & infra
paragraphs: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, and cloud object storage. Deployments on AWS, Azure, GCP, or VPS providers common in Bangladesh — with CI/CD via GitHub Actions or similar.

support-plans.title: Support plans
support-plans.intro: Software value compounds when production stays healthy. We offer tiered support after launch — from business-hours assistance to 24/7 critical incident response.

sections.title: Plan tiers
paragraphs: Plans are tailored; typical dimensions include:
list: Response time targets (e.g. 4h / 1h for critical)
Included hours for small enhancements
Security patch cadence and dependency updates
Monthly health report and uptime summary

sections.title: How to engage
paragraphs: Support can start at handover or after a warranty period. We review logs and incident history to recommend a realistic tier.

meta.title: Careers | HimoSoft
meta.description: Freelance, contract, and collaboration opportunities with HimoSoft.

careers.title: Freelance & contract roles
careers.intro: HimoSoft works with trusted specialists on defined scopes. If you have a strong portfolio and clear availability, we would like to hear from you.

sections.title: What we look for
paragraphs: We periodically need help in engineering, QA, design, and specialised domains (payments, mobile, DevOps). Engagements are project-based with written agreements.

sections.title: How to apply
paragraphs: Email via Contact with subject “Careers”, attach portfolio or GitHub, and note timezone and hourly or fixed engagement preference. We reply when there is a matching active need.
